name: Stance: Duelist's Form
descr:
Granted by [Duelist'S Form](/feat/duelist-s-form-battlecry)

You are Quickened while in this stance.You can use this extra action only to Step or use a single-action activity gained from the [Aldori duelist](/archetype/aldori-duelist-battlecry) archetype. If you use your free hand for anything, this stance ends. When this stance ends, you become fatigued until you rest for at least 10 minutes.

name: Stance: Jotun's Battle Stance
descr:
Granted by [Jotun'S Battle Stance](/feat/jotun-s-battle-stance-battlecry)

When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, the weapon gains a reach of 10 feet.
